name: @org.vibevm/eslint-plugin-ai-native
description: Custom @typescript-eslint rules for the AI-Native TypeScript discipline: the diagnostic-cites-req rule (Scaffold F) whose messages reproduce the engine's Class-F REQ-citation grammar exactly. Run directly with node >= 22.6 (type stripping); resolves @typescript-eslint/utils from the consumer's own typescript-eslint install at runtime, like its ts-extract / ts-oracle siblings.
